title: Code explanation and prompting lab tasks
summary: Students complete eight Explain-in-Plain-English tasks across two C programming labs by describing obfuscated functions to an LLM. They iteratively revise each description until generated code passes tests, with a 20-attempt limit and about 1% course credit.

sources.title: Explaining Code with a Purpose: An Integrated Approach for Developing Code Comprehension and Prompting Skills
sources.evidence_quote: Both Lab A and Lab B included four new code explanation tasks.

assessment.summary: Students complete eight Explain-in-Plain-English tasks across two C programming labs by describing obfuscated functions to an LLM.
student_actions: Describe the function's purpose in natural language.
Inspect LLM-generated code and test results.
Revise the prompt until the generated code is equivalent.
